token_sources.name: duel
token_sources.description: Primary session cookie. Issued by GET /api/v2/metadata and rebound by POST /api/v2/auth/login. HttpOnly.

token_sources.name: __cf_bm
token_sources.description: Cloudflare bot-management cookie, ~30 minute TTL. A 403 on replay almost always means this went stale, not that the path is wrong.

token_sources.name: x-duel-device-identifier
token_sources.description: Client-generated persistent v4 UUID. Mirrored in localStorage under 'security:uuid' and sent on every request. Server also accepts it as the ?uuid= query parameter on /metadata.

token_sources.name: x-env-class
token_sources.description: Environment class selector. Always 'main' for the production site.

token_sources.name: captcha_token
token_sources.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token. Feature flag captcha_on_login is enabled server-side, so login cannot be completed without a token minted by a real browser. Sent as {"type": "turnstile_token", "token": "<token>"} in the login body.

auth_failure_signals.description: Session absent or expired. Restore a captured session or re-authenticate.
Session-expired variant emitted by the SPA's axios interceptor.
Cloudflare bot-management rejection (cf-mitigated header, HTML body). Treat as stale __cf_bm and re-capture the session.
The SPA's response interceptor force-logs-out on any responseURL containing '/?logout'.

recovery_ladder.description: Re-run GET /api/v2/metadata to rebuild the bootstrap document and, if needed, mint a fresh device uuid.
POST /api/v2/metadata/socket-token to refresh the short-lived realtime credential (JWT, ~30s TTL; the SPA backs off on HTTP 429).
Disabled by design: captcha_on_login is enabled, so unattended re-authentication is not possible. Re-capture from a real browser instead.
Surface AuthRequired / CloudflareChallenge to the caller rather than silently retrying into an anti-bot flag.

endpoints.label: Place a dice bet (REAL MONEY)

request.body_text: {"amount":"<crypto amount string>","bet_type":"OVER|UNDER","currency":"<code>","security_token":"<token or empty>","target":"<roll target x100 as integer string>"}

endpoints.notes: Bundle-derived (useDice chunk: `m.post('bet', e)`; manual bet passes {amount, bet_type OVER|UNDER, currency, security_token, target}; target is the roll target x100, e.g. '5005' for 50.05. Response is {data: {round: {nonce, client_seed, server_seed_hashed, ...}}}. REAL-MONEY wagering: automated use almost certainly violates the operator's terms, risks account closure and forfeiture, and can lose funds fast. Exposed only via the reviewed place_dice_bet() path (dry-run default, betting_enabled + confirm + max_stake gates). security_token is '' when no extra security is required, else a token from POST /api/v2/user/security/token (may need a 2FA code). Batch/autobet variants exist in the SPA but are not wired.

provenance.client: Vue 3 SPA, axios-based ApiClient class, same-origin /api/v2

handshake_verified_in_bundle.server_draining_semantics: server asks clients to reconnect: fetch a fresh socket_token + socket_signature, disconnect, connect again (the SPA also debounces this at 3s)
handshake_verified_in_bundle.credential_refresh: credentials are short-lived (~30s) and re-fetched before every connect: POST /api/v2/metadata/socket-token when signed in, GET /api/v2/metadata when anonymous
handshake_verified_in_bundle.listener_implementation: realtime/betfeed.py (read-only; the only outbound event is identify)

out_of_scope: Any money movement other than the explicitly gated dice betting path
metadata.out_of_scope_reason: Duel.com is a real-money gaming site. Deposit, withdrawal and batch wagering stay excluded: automating them almost certainly violates the operator's terms of service, risks account closure and forfeiture of funds, and can cause rapid financial loss.

wagering.path: place_dice_bet() in automation_client.py plus the `dice-bet` CLI command - the only code permitted to touch money-moving endpoints
gates: parameters validated before anything is sent
dry_run=True by default: validates and returns the would-be payload without sending
live bets additionally require DuelClient(betting_enabled=True), per-call confirm=True, and amount <= max_stake
the generic request()/call path still refuses all money verbs unconditionally
wagering.warnings: Automated wagering almost certainly violates the operator's terms, risks account closure and forfeiture of funds, and can lose real money fast. Use only against an account you own, check the operator's terms first, never stake more than you can afford to lose, and prefer dry runs while developing. If gambling stops being fun, stop - see a problem-gambling helpline in your jurisdiction (e.g. 1-800-GAMBLER in the US, GamStop/GamCare in the UK).

metadata.terms_of_service_warning: Automated access to an account you do not operate is out of scope and unsupported. Automated wagering is available only through the explicitly gated dice path, against an account you own, after checking the operator's terms.
